candidates.description: This feature vector represents numeric values, specifically quantities or measurements in the lower-to-middle hundreds range.
This feature vector represents the Spanish word "mas" and various tokens containing the suffix or substring "-mas".
This feature vector represents linguistic tokens containing the letter sequence "mb" or the prefix/root "emb".
This vector represents word fragments and stems containing the Latin root "serv-" related to preservation, service, or cervical structures.
This vector represents common word-initial letter combinations and short prepositions starting with the letter 'A'.
This vector activates on word fragments and roots related to vulnerability, speed, and technical capabilities across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents biological, botanical, and agricultural terminology.
This vector represents accented characters, primarily vowels with acute accents common in various languages.
This feature vector represents forms, inflections, and auxiliary uses of the Portuguese verb 'ser' (to be) and related copular/modal verbs.
This vector represents biological organisms, their ecological environments, and geographical locations.
